import pathlib
programs=pathlib.Path(base)/'programs'; programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find rectangular frames: all four sides are a single color, with a non-frame interior.
    for r0 in range(h):
        for r1 in range(r0 + 2, h):
            for c0 in range(w):
                for c1 in range(c0 + 2, w):
                    color = grid[r0][c0]
                    if (all(grid[r0][c] == color for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)) and
                        all(grid[r1][c] == color for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)) and
                        all(grid[r][c0] == color and grid[r][c1] == color for r in range(r0, r1 + 1))):
                        interior = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0 + 1, r1) for c in range(c0 + 1, c1)]
                        if interior and all(x != color for x in interior):
                            fill = 2 if (c1 - c0 - 1) % 2 == 0 else 7
                            for r in range(r0 + 1, r1):
                                for c in range(c0 + 1, c1):
                                    out[r][c] = fill
    return out
'''
prog.write_text(code)
